title: Basic but functional unlabeled Ziplock bag organizer for a drawer; pricey
text:
Basic but functional unlabeled Ziplock bag organizer for a drawer; pricey. This is a basic and unlabeled four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. This cannot be hung on the wall unless someone drills holes through the unit. It is designed to be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are NO rubberized circles provided to prevent this from slipping around in a drawer. The bags can only be loaded through the opening.

This is a super basic but functional organizer. It does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets.

The current price of $29.89 is on the high competitively priced for this, especially since the compartments are not labeled, there are no hanging holes and screws with mollies provided, and no rubberized circles for the back. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
